target_customer: Engineering teams that build software with coding agents
problem: Coding agents make writing code fast, but engineers on a team still disagree about what to build. Scott is a planning workspace where teams align on a spec before agents start coding.
business_model: B2B SaaS for engineering teams (free trial download, demo for teams; pricing not found)
product_category: Spec and planning workspace for AI coding agents

founders.name: David Maulick
founders.background_notes: YC page: staff engineer and engineering manager at Coinbase working on developer platforms. Education not listed.

founders.name: Devin Cintron
founders.background_notes: YC page: founding engineer and head of mobile at Comun, earlier KP Engineering Fellow and Bain consultant.

competitors.name: Kiro (AWS)
competitors.what: Spec-driven agentic IDE (spec, design, tasks, implementation)

competitors.name: GitHub Spec Kit
competitors.what: Open-source toolkit for spec-driven development with Copilot, Claude Code and Gemini CLI

technical_complexity.rationale: A collaborative workspace that orchestrates several coding agents and compares their specs is standard product engineering with hard parts in agent orchestration and integrations with Claude and Cursor.

defensibility.rationale: Large vendors (AWS Kiro, GitHub Spec Kit) shipped spec-driven tooling within months of the batch and the category is crowded; team-level workflow lock-in is the only plausible moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Kiro reached general availability on November 17, 2025 and plan modes arrived in major coding tools; the company itself launched a 'Coding Agent Plan Mode' in November 2025.

market_need_then: Agent coding speeds up implementation, so alignment on what to build becomes the bottleneck for multi-engineer teams, according to the YC description. The spec-driven tooling wave of 2025 shows vendor attention to the same pain.

branding.domain_note: Uses tryscott.ai rather than scott.ai; the contact address is support@tryscott.ai.

identity.logo: Not described in any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Short and plain; the fetched site copy was a single line.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand; a first name used as a product name is hard to search for and clashes with people named Scott, including Cognition's Scott Wu, in results.

outcome_analysis: Scott AI is an active Fall 2025 company with a CEO from Coinbase and a CTO with startup and Stanford AI training. No acquisition or shutdown news was found. It entered a crowded spec-driven development category where AWS and GitHub shipped products in 2025, so outcomes depend on whether a neutral team planning layer beats bundled vendor features. Funding beyond the YC deal is not public.
notes: Sources conflict on funding: one job board says $500K pre-seed, another profile only says seed with no amount, and Crunchbase shows pre-seed with no amount. None is a primary source, so no round is recorded. The fetched tryscott.ai home page described 'shop estimations', which does not match the YC description; the content may be stale or from a different use of the domain, so the YC page was relied on. Team size is listed as 2 to 3 on YC and 3 to 5 elsewhere. One directory dates founding to 2024; YC says 2025. The $500K pre-seed rests on a single database (the-web-radar, with Crunchbase also labelling pre-seed without an amount); date and investors unknown, and that page dates founding to 2024, which conflicts with YC.
